description: Real-time communication platform. Industry brain defines the context and purpose of communication. This core defines how messaging, channels, and real-time interaction work.

three_js.description: Small rectangular particles drifting upward like message bubbles floating. Clusters form and dissolve. Minimal and clean.
three_js.avoid: no status pills, no hero-stat-line, no ticker strips

relationships: Conversation is between two or more Users
Message belongs to Conversation, sent by User
Channel is a group Conversation with a topic
Attachment belongs to Message — file, image, video
Reaction belongs to Message, sent by User
Notification belongs to User, triggered by new Message or mention
Contact is a User saved by another User
Group is a named Conversation with many Users
Call is initiated between Users, can be voice or video
Status belongs to User — online, away, busy, offline
Bot is a special User type that sends automated Messages

Slash command autocomplete — / triggers command list in input
Breakout room assignment — drag and drop members into rooms

Meeting transcription indicator — live text scrolls during call

layout.notes: Input bar must always be above keyboard on iPhone — never hidden. On iPad and desktop the thread and list are always simultaneously visible — never full-screen navigate away from list.

avoid: Never use pagination in a chat thread — always infinite scroll upward to load history
Never show timestamps on every message — show time at start of each day cluster only
Never use a modal for attachments — inline attachment preview in the message bubble
Never show typing indicator for more than 30 seconds — it becomes noise
Never auto-mark messages as read until the conversation is opened and scrolled to
Never use red bubbles for sent messages — red is exclusively for errors
Never truncate message preview in conversation list to less than 1 line
Never show a send button that is active on an empty input
enforce: Message status: single tick = sent, double tick = delivered, filled double tick = read
Typing indicator — animated dots — appears within 1 second of other user typing
Input bar always above keyboard — never hidden when keyboard is open
Swipe right on message to reply — quoted message appears in input
Long press opens context menu: reply, react, copy, delete, forward
Unread count badge on conversation row — disappears when conversation opened
Online status indicator — green dot on avatar when online
Message sent sound/haptic — subtle, respects device settings

empty_states.ui: Message bubble illustration. Message: 'No messages yet'. CTA: 'Start a conversation'. Secondary: 'Find contacts'.
Contact name and avatar centred. First message prompt: 'Say hello to [name]'. Input bar ready and focused. No empty thread lines.
Message: 'No messages found for [query]'. Suggestions: check spelling, search in different conversation.

loading_states.ui: Skeleton conversation rows — avatar circle, name line, preview line, time stamp right. 5 skeleton rows shimmer.
History loads from bottom — skeleton bubbles appear at top while scrolling up. New messages always appear at bottom immediately.
Image messages show placeholder with spinner while loading. Tap to retry if failed. Video shows thumbnail immediately, stream on play.

error_flows.ui: Message bubble shows red warning icon right side. Tap warning: 'Message failed to send'. Options: Retry, Delete. Never silently drop the message.
Messages show single tick only — never delivered. No error shown to sender — privacy protection. Input remains active.
Inline error before sending: 'File too large. Maximum [size]'. File not attached. Other message content preserved.
Message queued with clock icon. 'Sending when connected...' status. Auto-sends when connection restored. Never lost.

edge_cases.ui: Message bubble wraps naturally. No character limit shown during compose unless approaching limit. Read more not needed in chat — show full message.
Member list paginated. Typing indicator shows '[Name] and 2 others are typing' — not all names. Read receipts show count not all avatars.
Message shows 'Edited' label with edit timestamp. Original message not shown. Edit history accessible by long press.
Waveform visualisation in bubble. Playback position scrubable. Speed control: 1x 1.5x 2x. Duration shown before and during playback.
